comment: Six outputs are declared with no widget: the four per-lane offset-head values and the loop trigger the manual describes, which have no jacks on this panel. A write parameter is marked retired in place and given no widget, because parameters and inputs are saved by index and removing one would repatch every saved patch. The write gate input carries the same retired wording in its tooltip and says it has no jack on the panel, but trace.cpp:1633 does place a jack for it and trace.cpp:601 does read it: with a cable patched, the draw CV inputs record only while it is at or above 1V. The read is a proper resampling of the paper rather than nearest-neighbour.
